name: SailMaine Junior Sailing at Centerboard Yacht Club
description_short: One-week sailing classes for ages 8 to 12 run by SailMaine at Centerboard Yacht Club on the South Portland waterfront. Beginner and intermediate sailors learn rigging, steering and boat handling in small boats, mornings, afternoons or all day.
swim_waterfront_notes: Sailing in the sheltered inner harbor in JY Trainers and Optimist dinghies. Sailors must be under 125 lbs and pass a swim test on the first day: swim 25 yards and tread water 2 to 3 minutes in a life jacket.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund more than 3 weeks before the start, 50% between 3 weeks and 1 week before, no refund within 1 week.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Centerboard section: ages 8 to 12, full day $578, half day $289 per one-week session. Scholarships from $25 to full cost.
